about_the_game:
TAKE COMMAND OF THE NATION'S AIR DEFENSE

The sky is your battlefield. A hostile contact appears on radar. Is it a civilian airliner off course, or the prelude to a full-scale attack? Your job is to find out.

Air Defender Sim is a high-stakes, real-time strategy simulation that puts you in the command chair of a national Air Defense network. From a top-down strategic view, you are the unseen hand responsible for detecting, identifying, and intercepting airborne threats. This is not a dogfighting game; you are not a pilot. You are the commander, and the fate of the nation rests on your split-second decisions.

Analyze radar returns, scramble your Quick Reaction Alert (QRA) fighters, and manage your assets to protect your airspace. Every choice matters, and the consequences of failure are devastating.

Key Features

  • High-Fidelity Command & Control: Take on the role of an Air Defense Commander. Manage a detailed radar network, interpret IFF (Identification Friend or Foe) data, and issue commands to your forces.

  • Scramble QRA Interceptors: Launch your fighter aircraft to investigate, shadow, or engage hostile contacts. Manage their fuel, weapons, and mission objectives in real-time.

  • Deep Information Warfare: Utilize authentic-inspired systems to build a complete picture of the battlespace. Monitor flight plans, analyze electronic warfare (EW) intelligence, and stay one step ahead of the enemy.

  • Intelligent Enemy AI: Face a dynamic adversary that will probe your defenses, launch coordinated attacks, and adapt to your strategy, creating a challenging and replayable experience.

  • Scenario-Based Gameplay: Undertake a variety of challenging missions, from peacetime sovereignty patrols to high-intensity conflict scenarios.

Welcome to the command center. The watch is yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: A graphics card with DX10 (Shader Model 4.0) capabilities.
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
